questionText:

"One of the fiercest debates in the Constituent Assembly centered on the allocation of powers between the Centre and the States. Defending provincial rights, K. If you burden the Centre with too many administrative responsibilities and starve the provinces of fiscal revenues, the Centre will inevitably break down under its own weight.
